To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
various functional nanomaterial-based flexible and stretchable electronic devices have been developed for wearable electronics.

the combination of nanomaterials with diverse mechanical properties can provide multifunctional wearable devices that have a wide range of application in human-machine interface, human healthcare and smart clothing.

(i) the use of various nanomaterials enables us to fabricate flexible and stretchable wearable electronics, (ii) the integration of nanomaterials with functional nanomaterial particles enables us to achieve various functions in wearable devices, (iii) we have developed wearable devices that can be used in the real world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new nanomaterials, their hybridization, and device integration for wearable electronics.
the design, synthesis, and characterization of functional nanomaterial-based devices for wearable electronics.
the development of new functional nanomaterial-based devices with deformable structures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integration of various nanomaterials into wearable electronics is a promising approach to achieve high-performance devices with multifunctionality and/or low cost.
the integration of nanomaterials with soft substrates and/or deformable structures has opened up a new horizon of wearable electronics.
nanomaterials-based wearable electronics will continue to play a major role in the development of the wearable electronics industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development and integration of nanomaterials into wearable devices have opened up a new era of electronics and sensors.
nanotechnology can provide a new paradigm for the next generation of wearable electronics.
the integration of nanomaterials with various functional properties is a powerful approach for the development of next-generation wearable electronics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nanomaterials are key components to enable the next generation of wearable devices.
the combination of nanomaterials with different properties and functionalities will be a key to the realization of wearable electronic devices with high performance, multifunctionality, and low cost.
the development of deformable devices with integrated multifunctional nanomaterials is an effective strategy for realizing the next generation wearable electronics.
